export type StatusTone = "neutral" | "accent" | "warning" | "critical" | "info" | "positive"

# Tabla de trabajo

Clean-room de una tabla de trabajo con columnas y filas arrastrables. No se copió código, datos ni assets de librerías de pago. La pieza hereda los tokens del anfitrión y no trae tema.

## Instalar

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @retana/work-table
npx shadcn@latest add @retana/work-table-toolbar
npx shadcn@latest add @retana/work-table-cells
```

Variantes:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @retana/work-table-board
npx shadcn@latest add @retana/work-table-tree
npx shadcn@latest add @retana/work-table-queue
npx shadcn@latest add @retana/work-table-support
```

Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir `button`, `checkbox`, `dropdown-menu`, `input`, `select`, `table`, `tooltip`, `avatar`, `popover`, `skeleton` o `status-pill`, la respuesta es **no**.

Los datos cambian solo por `onReorder`, `onMove`, `onUpdate`, `onAssign` y `onRemove`. No hay SDK de backend en `ui/`.

api.name: rows / columns
api.description: Rows need an id. A column cell receives the row and its index.

api.name: mode
api.description: Flat paginates. Grouped buckets by status. Tree indents by parent.

api.name: onMove / onReorder
api.description: Adapter. onMove receives the next rows. There is no backend SDK.

api.name: onAssign / onRemove / onUpdate
api.description: Bulk assign, destructive row action, and a field patch.

api.name: persistenceKey / layoutApi
api.description: Optional localStorage key, or a layout hook the host already owns.

api.name: state
api.description: Empty, loading, and error are built in. onRetry sits on the error state.

docs: Clean-room work table. Behavior only: no paid-library source, sample rows, icons, or assets. Columns and rows reorder with dnd-kit (pointer and keyboard) and announce through aria-live. Layout presets can persist in localStorage. Reduced motion skips transitions. Status tones come from status-pill and status-tone.ts. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, checkbox, dropdown-menu, input, select, skeleton, table, tooltip, status-pill, reorder, or status-tone. The item ships no theme.
